notes.title: 🔪 Inside The Coma #7: Please meet Miyeong, Eunae & Narsha!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/5a242be4f2c44bb3b2fc01a5198b8f7b7a8b525b.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our seventh issue of "Inside The Coma"!

After escaping from The Coma, Youngho returns to school and, having forgotten about his horrifying experience, starts growing interested in girls, as adolescent boys do.

At Youngho's school, many girls who seem to be friends with him! Firstly, there's [b]Mina[/b] from Class C. Mina is also the protagonist of The Coma 2, and a childhood friend of Youngho's from the same neighborhood who he's been close to for a long time. They're in different classes on different floors, so their interactions have become less frequent, but they still walk to school together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/11015cd2d091b8b2f2a1b0de9998d6c4d970bf24.jpg[/img]

[b]Miyeong[/b] is a good student in her class, perhaps it's because she spends all her time studying. She takes her grades and achievements very seriously, studying at various tutoring academies until late at night. Although she is sometimes embarrassed by the boys who approach her, she is usually calm, intelligent, and even arrogant at times.

In Youngho's class is a girl from the United States, called [b]Narsha[/b]. She is very outgoing, sociable, and good-looking, which makes her popular with many of the boys. She even seems to have potential as a K-pop idol, but considering that idol wannabes usually start training in middle school, it might be a little too late. Will she win Youngho's heart with her bright smile and affection?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVCWWsucS38

And we can't forget about [b]Eunae[/b]! She's very gentle, introverted, and compassionate. She's always kind to Youngho. However, she doesn't handle the stress of school and her parents' high expectations very well. If you like her, you'll need to give her a little more courage and energy.

Who will win Youngho as a boyfriend? It's all about your choices and focus!

Oh, but one more thing: this is a horror game, and you should be aware that there will be enough elements to interrupt your love story.

Talk to you again really soon!
Minho & Dvora Studio


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1781890/The_Coma_2B_Catacomb/

notes.title: 🔪 Inside The Coma #4: Please meet Youngho!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/1b95707abc1aedcb5b424741ad87987f38660eb4.jpg[/img]

Everything could be a spoiler!

But I will still give a brief introduction of Youngho, because this high school freshman is the protagonist of the last game, The Coma 1, as well as the protagonist of this game. To recap The Coma 1 without giving away any spoilers I'll just say this much: he's a student at Sehwa Private High School, and he's only been in high school for a few months. The Korean Education System usually enrolls new students in March and have their final exams around the end of June, so it's been about 3.5 months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/728de113a4275a5bc1c456c91b702651117e396d.jpg[/img]

For some unforeseen reason, Youngho falls asleep during the exam (or maybe it's after?) and ends up in the mirror dimension "The Coma". There, he encounters monsters and ghosts ... and eventually has to escape the nightmare school, which is the story of The Coma 1, although a lot of it is left out ... He doesn't have any special powers, but his indomitable will and observation skills help him get through the crisis.

In this new game, we get to know Youngho's family history and background indirectly, which helps us understand how he has this personality and mindset. There are subtle differences between Youngho's personality in The Coma 1 and Youngho's personality in The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters. It can be said that he has grown a bit more, and the reason why is revealed in The Coma 2B: Catacomb. So, stay tuned!

Talk to you again really soon!
Minho & Dvora Studio

notes.title: 🔪 Inside The Coma #3: The Order of The Coma explained
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/eb180e8839718bcfcc0b53ea7e80a270f681d773.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our third issue of "Inside The Coma"!

[b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] is separate from the sequential flow of previous works. If The Coma 1 and 2 came out, shouldn't a third The Coma be coming out now? Not necessarily, because there are some important and mysterious gaps between the first and second that we want to fill.

[b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] needs to be a bridge between the first game and second one, but it also needs to be a game for both newcomers to the world of The Coma who have only seen it on YouTube, and players who have enjoyed the first two games and are looking for a new instalment.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/934a3d7a54549108af362d18d6dbcdc0c3c89963.png[/img]
 
[quote] We're often asked why there is [b]The Coma: Cutting Class[/b] and [b]The Coma: Recut[/b], and why [b]The Coma: Cutting Glass[/b] is no longer available. The short answer is that The Coma: Recut is an enhanced version of the same game. In 2017, we began to work on porting the game to consoles. This gave us the opportunity to revisit the project by adding some new features, polishing the graphics, and refining elements of the story. It was later released with this rebranded title.

We gave the game a darker, more menacing tone. A large part of what makes The Coma an intriguing setting is the mystery that surrounds the Shadow Realm and the unexplainable phenomenon visitors may experience within. Since we had a chance to revise the graphics, we embraced an eldritch horror aesthetic to better frame the world’s sinister atmosphere. It’s our love letter to H. P. Lovecraft and the Cthulhu mythos. Most importantly, it represents the actual game we wanted to deliver. [/quote] 

The game brings back the protagonist from the first game, Youngho. As you'll know if you've played [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b], the protagonist is a girl named Mina, who is neighbours and long-time friends with the protagonist of the first game. Their escape story is told in [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b], but it was not from Youngho's perspective, so a lot of things are left unexplained.
 
[b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] begins with both the normal and true ending of The Coma 1. Many people were curious about the true ending, which was included in the remastered version of The Coma 1. It was clear that Youngho had escaped from the world of The Coma! So it was the purpose of this game's introduction to deal with both different endings. The opening sequence is a bit old-school style, but if you remember your slow and boring high school life, you'll be able to spot the oddities.
 
Due to the chronological order, if you're wondering which game to play first between [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b] and The Coma 2B: Catacomb, I'd recommend playing [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b] first, as many of the things that you thought were disconnected or weird will be revealed in [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b]. If you decide you want to play [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] first, feel free to do so; you'll be able to play [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b] from an omniscient writer's perspective then.

Talk to you again really soon!
Minho & Dvora Studio


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1781890/The_Coma_2B_Catacomb/

notes.title: 🔪 Inside The Coma #2: Back when The Coma began
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/e304f8ecd13cfb645210a8e46c16e9aed9bd3379.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our second issue of "Inside The Coma"!

This time it's about how The Coma series began almost 10 years ago.

Surprisingly, The Coma series is already on its third instalment. ‘Surprisingly’ because back then I would never have dreamed what would come of our debut game. The Coma 1 has fairly classic graphics, but a lot of players love it for its own unique artwork and style, and many people still get a kick of playing it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/f1c7c5b0bfe2426ac12288769d4aaf8577cd0e70.png[/img]

The beauty of this game series, and I'm a little embarrassed to say this as a director, is that many people have said that this "horror" game doesn't trigger unpleasant emotions and fears so much that it makes you stop playing, but rather draws you into the story, painting a picture of overcoming your fears and overcoming adversity to reach the ending.

At the end of the game, instead of thinking, "Wow, this game was really scary", the players think, "Wow, the story of the main character was interesting". This narrative is all the more interesting because it starts with an episode of an ordinary high school student in a unique and exotic culture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/83311e8789bf230b13bd6538f6823f569b2dd8e4.png[/img]

As you follow the story of the main character, who may be living in a completely different culture, you gain information and knowledge that you didn't know before, and you endure the fear and experience the process with him.

The game isn't scary enough to appear in your dreams, but it does send players into a panic in some situations. The traps are easy to overcome, and the controls aren't difficult. But when the killer appears and chases you when you least expect it, you'll find yourself making mistakes that you shouldn't, and you'll be gasping for breath over and over again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/da114cee0006172bb36437b2d40519e429e38725.png[/img]

Why are you suffering so much for a trap that you could have easily avoided? The constantly dark environment and physically limited left and right field of view keep you on your toes, even though the game is 2D and has a third-person perspective. The game is nowhere near as good as the first and second instalments, but it's laying the groundwork for the series to expand a bit more.

The series is very interesting to me, and it has great potential because it combines the society I live in, my own past experiences, and the stories I hear from the current young generation. I don't know how many more great stories I can come up with, but I'm racking my brain.

Talk to you again really soon!
Minho & Dvora Studio


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1781890/The_Coma_2B_Catacomb/

notes.title: 🔪 Inside The Coma #1: Meet The Coma-Developer Dvora Studio!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/4c5204a874242dfa4f05d564a3054cbacf1c84e8.jpg[/img]

Happy Friday, Ghost Vigilantes!

Before unleashing [b]The Coma 2B. Catacomb[/b] later this year, we want to tell you more about the game with the "Inside The Coma" update series. But not only about the game, but also about us: Dvora Studio - the team behind titles like Vambrace, Scarlet Hood and - of course - The Coma.

[b]Dvora Studio[/b] was founded on the 28th August 2015, but I spent one year working in cafes in order to make the first game in the Coma Series. The formal company name was [b]Devespresso Games[/b] (Dev + Espresso Coffee), as this was what shaped the first few years of my indie game development life. I changed the name to Dvora Studio later on, because it was easier to remember.

Back then, we struggled to secure a programmer who could actually build the game. I'm a graphic artist with a bunch of cool stories, but I need to have someone who actually create the games with me. Those seats were taken by two programmer friends, who were later replaced by my cousin, and eventually filled with three indie game programmers now.

To create the narrative stories and events, I requested custom modules and DB forms to shape the visuals of the games by myself for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/904380/Vambrace_Cold_Soul/]Vambrace: Cold Soul[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045720/The_Coma_2_Vicious_Sisters/]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141120/Scarlet_Hood_and_the_Wicked_Wood/]Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood[/url]. It added a lot to my workload, but I think it was possible because I wasn't married with kids back then, because it was so rewarding to work day and night to get the game done and to share the story and the characters and the world with gamers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/604811b87f664547e29577a8816cc31ec99f4665.png[/img]
T. L. Riven and KYNO have been a huge part of that journey. They've kept my imagination and inspiration flowing and helped me stay on track to keep making games. The stories that T. L. Riven has built on top of my ideas have been amazing and exciting, and he's gone on to do some amazing things as a game writer and is now a game producer for another company. KYNO is now a brand new game designer, designing and creating sophisticated and highly playable games.

I’m grateful that the games we make have been described by many as having 'unique artwork, beautiful music, and immersive, detailed worlds', which has led to a lot of people who love and remember these game worlds (The Coma Series & Vambrace Saga), and it's a pleasure to work for them.

Now I'm married, and I'm a dad with two babies to look after. Obviously, I look at the world differently, I have a different sense of purpose, and making a game with those experiences adds a different depth than before. I want to continue to make games that people remember. I want to make games for as long as I have the energy.

There are currently six developers working at the company, including myself, and we're braving the unbearably hot Korean summer weather. I know a lot of people are surprised at how six people can produce two game projects, but it's actually happening. We have a lot of ideas in our heads, and we can't wait to show them off.

Talk to you again really soon!
Minho & Dvora Studio


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1781890/The_Coma_2B_Catacomb/

Through a series of unfortunate events, she finds herself in charge of leading a hapless Munchkin troupe through the Wicked Wood to safety. One problem - the cantankerous Black Witch, LeFaba, has a habit of incinerating would-be travelers that detour through her forest. Can our fledgling pathfinder take up the mantle of the Red Witch and summon the moxie to overcome the disaster that awaits her at every turn?

notes.title: Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood - LIVE ACTION TRAILER
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=_eBFerc4sDI;full][/previewyoutube]

Howdy folks!

Devespresso Games is pleased to announce that Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood will be dropping on Steam tomorrow (April 8th)! This game has been one year in the making and directly follows on the heels of our last title, The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters. Our players will be happy to know that this title is jam-packed with our distinct visuals and story-driven gameplay. So, make sure to join us in welcoming Scarlet, the newest member of our gaming universe, to the family!

We filmed a special live-action trailer to celebrate the occasion and it JUST went live. Check it out above!

[h2]Synopsis
[/h2]
Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood is the story of a young woman who finds herself tossed into the magical realm of Glome by a rogue tornado. It is there she must take up the mantle of the “Red Witch” and learn to wield her powerful Womping Stick to help a troupe of lost Munchkin safely navigate their way through the perilous domain of the Black Witch, LeFaba. The evil sorceress has no qualms about destroying any unwary intruders that trespass in The Wicked Wood. While Scarlet may be completely outmatched, she soon learns a recursion hex has her reliving the same day. Can she use her newfound powers and the knowledge gained from her previous lives to outwit LeFaba and lead the troupe to safety?

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29663532/2dd8faa0995468add645e516c988e6c32ae000a1.jpg[/img]
Many of you may be wondering what to expect this time around. If you’re a fan of puzzle-solving/adventure games you’ll feel right at home in “The Wicked Wood.” This game has more puzzles than you can shake a stick at. There are also multiple paths to success featuring 10 unique endings to be unlocked. But just because this game more heavily focuses on puzzles doesn’t mean that it skimps on action; you’ll have to avoid the bumbling Dodobo, mischievous Monkeyta, and a relentless wolf to survive this forest.  

[h2]Discord[/h2]
[url=https://discord.com/invite/devespresso][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29663532/2b6d16d2fbe5d54ff1e8ff624d478f4372de9b7a.jpg[/img][/url]
Make sure to join our friendly Discord server for exclusive updates, to connect with like-minded gamers, and chat with the devs. We'll be sure to nudge you in the right direction if you've been stuck on a puzzle "too" long as well. ;)   

We're looking forward to meeting all of you!

notes.title: The Coma 2 - Major Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29663532/304756c2c99e5878d045004b66c3a828c1c75bd7.jpg[/img]

[h3]The end is nigh![/h3]
In 2 hours, we release Patch 0.3.0 of The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters. The final chapter of Mina’s journey is finally revealed. Now it’s time for you to finish the fight! Can you survive the peril that awaits? For players who have been searching for answers after the events of The Coma: Cutting Class/Recut, you will not be disappointed.

The Patch goes live on December 28th:

USA - 6AM Eastern Standard Time
GERMANY - 12 PM Central European Time
RUSSIA - 2 PM Moscow Standard Time
CHINA - 7 PM China Standard Time
KOREA - 8 PM Korea Standard Time

While the game will be fully playable from beginning to end, we must note that it's STILL in Early Access. That means it won't have the extra content we're planning to implement before the full launch - trust us, there are some pretty sweet goodies in store for our most devoted players.

The game is still 20% off for the Steam Winter Sale. Jump in while you can because all Early Access users are getting the Game Soundtrack and Art Book free - our personal way to do right by the players who have graciously supported us throughout the game's rough development cycle.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045720/The_Coma_2_Vicious_Sisters/

[h3]Now an important announcement:[/h3]
We regret to inform everyone that ALL Early Access save data will be reset when the game goes live. Due to the nature of the updates we'll be implementing we need to do this so the final game functions properly. We apologize for any inconvenience this causes and hope for your understanding. That said, there is a silver lining with this: ALL the Steam Achievements you've earned will remain unlocked. 

[h3]Join us![/h3]
[url=www.discord.gg/devespresso][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29663532/ee49cc2fa7e5b8dcd88721fa6f776c5369cfa9a6.jpg[/img][/url]

Please continue sharing your valuable feedback. It's going to be more important than ever as we get closer to full release. With your amazing help, we've been able to improve The Coma 2 - helping it to become the 25th highest-rated game on Steam this past quarter! That has been a truly humbling experience for us and we look forward to improving the game even more.

As always, please join our Discord server www.discord.gg/devespresso - we LOVE interacting with the community and hearing your thoughts. We especially enjoy watching lore and character discussions unfold. We have dedicated channels for just about every language and topic, so feel free to drop by and join the fun!

notes.title: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters (0.2.5) is live - Including the next 3 Chapters!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29663532/85a6c2a72a81941e1ff17ba3e64146f22088091c.png[/img]

Howdy Folks!

'The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters' (Version 0.2.5) is officially here! We hope you're as excited to jump into the next 3 chapters of the game as we are to share them. In addition to that content, we've also done extensive QOL work on the first 3 chapters and the game as a whole. We were able to accomplish this with the community's invaluable feedback. Please continue to share your opinions or any bugs you find through Discord [www.discord.gg/devespresso] or right here on the Steam Discussion boards.

We have done multiple playthroughs where we don't encounter any significant issues. We still stumble across the odd bug or typo here and there though. Remember, the game is still in Early Access until January. So, you can expect to encounter a few hiccups. If you do, please report it and we'll patch it right away. IF you do encounter an issue, it will probably fall into one of these categories:

[list]
[*] Minor graphical glitches
[*] Typos in the script
[*] Random bugs
[*] Aberrant or missing sound effects
[*] An AI that doesn't always function as intended
[*] Missing content (Bonus wallpapers, etc.)
[/list]


Finally, onto some of the fixes. Frankly, they're too numerous to really outline, but here are the major changes:

[h1]SCRIPT CHANGES[/h1]
So many lines of dialogue from Chapters 1-3 were adjusted to either serve their intended nuances or fix typos.


[h1]CRAFTING[/h1]
[list]
[*] Double-crafting bug Fixed
[*] Crafting after the chapter bug fixed
[*] Crafting Difficulty corrected - it will be more challenging.
[*] Crafting Resource loot events will be disabled after each chapter.
[/list]

[h1]STORY[/h1]
[list]
[*] [Chapter 1]: We made the Storage Room telescope functional in The Coma since most gamers skip it entirely in the Waking World.
[*] [Chapter 3]: Fixed apothecary scenario skip to pick up the Grimseng.
[*] [Chapter 3]: One more note was added about the Dokkaebi.
[*] Language Update: General fixes and adjustments
[/list]


[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Logo image correction (Size and spelling)
[*] Erased the herbal store’s background.
[*] The Butcher’s animations were improved.
[/list]


[h1]GAME BALANCE[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adjusted loot events based on player feedback.
[*] Shadow Stalker Speed has increased.
[/list]


[h1]PATH[/h1]
[list]
[*] Invisible wall correction
[*] Dark Song/Butcher chase freeze bug fix.
[*] Barricaded doors fix.
[*] School structure was edited for story expansion. (Location & inner event fix)
[*] Fixed the 1F Right Wing Hallway of the school.
[*] Patrol Route updates & corrections.
[*] General loot event updates.
[*] Moved a Noxious Fumes bomb Trap that hit people as they arrived in the Bio Lab.
[*] Back-locked Doors: Added sounds for unlocking locked doors from the inside.
[*] Operational sounds on keypad combinations were added.
[/list]


[h1]GUI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Wight Burrows have a map-checker icon now.
[*] The tutorials menu has been updated adjusted and new content was added.
[*] Tutorial update.
[*] Lighter: Activating it is not the "F" key instead of "T" (which is used for Spectral Matches).
[*] Item descriptions have been updated.
[*] The cost of some items has changed.
[/list]


[h1]DIALOGUE[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dimmed portraits were corrected.
[*] Dialogue portraits were corrected.
[*] Added Mina’s portraits to more interactive events.
[/list]


[h1]SOUND[/h1]
[list]
[*] Hyung-bae, the mysterious man, has had a voice correction.
[*] Manhwa Cutscenes had sound fixes.
[*] Various SFX were added.
[/list]


[h1]KOREAN LOCALIZATION[/h1]
국문 번역 전체적 수정 - 좀 더 디테일한 이야기 전개 및 캐릭터 심리묘사 및 발전 단계 구축.


Early Access has giving us the opportunity to really make The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters the best it can be. Thanks again to everyone for the amazing support! You guys really keep us going. The next update will be in mid-December for the closing chapter of Mina's journey.

Team Devespresso, out!

notes.title: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters Official Trailer Debut
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33788427/5371d3928073766cf3e845021cc4520ef4a8bc88.png[/img]

Devespresso Games is proud to announce that THE COMA 2: VICIOUS SISTERS, the long-awaited sequel to its Korean-horror cult classic will make its playable debut as part of the Indie MegaBooth lineup at PAX West 2019. The game will be available as part of the MiniBooth showcase on Friday, August 30th and Saturday, August 31st. The game’s booth will be located on the 4th floor in the Main Expo Hall.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GZdRoU8BikE]Check out the trailer here.[/url]
 
[h1]SYNOPSIS[/h1]
Mina Park, a student of Sehwa High, awakens at night in her school. It isn’t long before she realizes that something is amiss. The once-familiar surroundings looks twisted by something dark and sinister. She finds herself pursued by someone or something that looks eerily like her teacher. To survive, Mina must venture beyond the boundaries of Sehwa High and into the surrounding district. There, she will encounter strange creatures, mysterious strangers, and uneasy allies.

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters is an atmospheric, story-driven game. Immerse yourself in the warped Sehwa district as you encounter an engaging cast of characters, solve puzzles, discover revealing clues, and fight for survival against a relentless psycho.

Heroines, forced to confront their worst fears, rarely emerge unscathed. Over the course of the story, Mina will encounter dangerous scenarios from which she could sustain permanent damage. Craft items to anticipate future dangers to avoid injury.

Dark Song is now more fearsome and powerful than ever before. Falling into her grasp could spell instant death. Running and wielding your flashlight makes you an easy target. You must precariously balance the urgency of exploration with your absolute need to survive!  
 
[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
 
[b]A Relentless killer[/b]
Fear Dark Song’s relentless pursuit to kill you, now with an all-new AI.
 
[b]Survival Crafting[/b]
Craft items to prepare for critical life-or-death situations or risk permanent injury.
 
[b]Explore[/b]
Explore the nightmarish district that surrounds Sehwa High and discover its dark secrets.
 
[b]Scavenge[/b]
Search for resources and tools to survive deadly encounters and afflictions and to progress into unexplored areas.
 
[b]Hide[/b]
Hide to avoid detection and certain death. Pass challenges to conceal your location. 
 
[b]Hand-Illustrated Graphics[/b]
Featuring vibrant, hand-illustrated graphics and Korean manhwa-style visuals.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29663532/c07702b6087078167844db1e051bb7d1a3ae5e10.jpg[/img]

1. STUCK BUGFIX: Thank the efforts of our colleagues at Stage Clear, we swatted an annoying bug which causes Youngho to get stuck right after trying to hold your breath.

2. SPANISH EDITION: Yes! Players can finally dive into the Coma and enjoy the horror in Español. We’re able to bring you this amazing translation thanks to the efforts of Miguel Avila. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Patch News!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29663532/b65ac37260fee42d94de7b38b6c7299370512899.png[/img]

1. Hold-Your-Breath Bug Patch:
 After watching a few streams, we realized there is some kinda bug that immobilizes the player and drains your SP. This happens when you use the interact button rapidly right after holding your breath. We added a small delay right after the breath holding action to address this issue. ːhideː


2. Japanese language patch: 
When you have a full backpack and try to buy items from a vending machine, Youngho says "Spanish!" instead of "My bag is full..." So, we taught him how to speak properly. ːwhiteheartː


3. Controller Tutorials: 
Have you ever used a XB1 controller with this game? Some control settings are slightly different from the tutorial images, so we also fixed that. ːfocusedː


4. Removed scream detection signal: 
When it comes to the console version, it's quite difficult to figure out which direction the killer is coming from. Since most console gamers will be playing the game in front of big screen like TV. But when you are playing in front of your PC or Mac, you’ll probably be using a headset to feel this game. The shouting sound is stereo, so if you listen carefully, you’ll know which direction she’s coming from, even without the UI. ːhideː


Minho | Devespresso Games

notes.title: The Coma: Recut – OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JIQZd6I.gif[/img]

Hey horror fans – class is now in session! By which I mean, The Coma: Recut has launched and is now available to purchase either right here on Steam or, if you prefer, [url=https://www.gog.com/game/the_coma_recut] over at GOG [/url]. (It also arrived this week on PS4 and Xbox One, so if you're a console guy/gal just lurking around these parts, then you're catered for as well.) 

Of course, as we previously announced, if you own the original game – The Coma: Cutting Class – you'll be able to enjoy The Coma: Recut for no charge. You'll get it on Steam for free. You pay no money. It's 100% gratis. Nothing scary about that.

Anyway, whether you're a return visitor to the creepy corridors of Sehwa High or a fearless first timer, we hope your experience with The Coma: Recut is a thrilling/terrifying one.

Matt | Digerati Distribution

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29663532/b65ac37260fee42d94de7b38b6c7299370512899.png[/img]
